overview.headline: Wright flight fundamentals, aerodynamics lessons and aircraft simulations overview

keyPoints.point: Fundamentals and lessons are presented to help understand the journey of flight.
keyPoints.quote: These fundamentals and lessons will help you understand their journey of flight.

keyPoints.point: The collection shows basic math and physics that led to invention of the airplane.
keyPoints.quote: The Wright Way will show you the basic math and physics that led to the invention of the airplane by the Wright Brothers.

keyPoints.point: Elevators are found at the front of the aircraft as movable control surfaces.
keyPoints.quote: At the front of all of the Wright brothers’ aircraft one finds the elevators.

keyPoints.point: The machine is described as the first piloted aircraft that was heavier than air.
keyPoints.quote: This machine was the first piloted aircraft that was heavier than air, ...
